_doc: Strangers on the road with paying work. Ours, not the original game's — tools/build-emberveil-data.mjs never touches this file. A `dialog` node can turn up one of these instead of a random event: an NPC offers a one-off bounty aimed at a real, uncleared node in a zone the party has open. They pay better than the town board (goldBase + goldPerAct × act, times the offer's `pay`) because you have to be out there to be offered one. An accepted road quest is an ordinary side quest from then on: it shows in the Quests tab, it puts a marker on the map, and checkSideQuests() pays it out when the node is cleared.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You look like people who solve things. I carry letters, and one of them is about {target}.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Whoever is sitting there has stopped the post twice. The guild pays for quiet roads.

offers.accept: She marks {target} on your map with a thumbnail of red wax. "Come back through Crowsfoot and say it is done."
offers.decline: She shrugs, tucks the letter away and walks on faster than you would think possible.
offers.title: The Stopped Post
offers.text: A courier wants {target} cleared so the letters move again.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My husband went as far as {target} and no further. I would like to know it is empty now.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I have his wages. I have no use for them.

offers.accept: She counts the coin out twice, the way people do when the number matters more than the money. "{target}," she says. "That is all."
offers.decline: She nods as though she expected it, and goes back to looking down the road.
offers.title: His Wages
offers.text: Clear {target}. A widow is paying with her husband's last wages.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Straight business. My wagons will not go past {target} while it is held.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I pay better than a town board because a town board cannot reach you out here.

offers.accept: He writes a bond, stamps it with a wheel-and-hammer seal, and hands it over without a smile. "{target}. Before the frost."
offers.decline: "Then I will find somebody with fewer scruples and worse armour." He waves the wagons on.
offers.title: The Blocked Run
offers.text: A caravan factor pays above the board rate to see {target} cleared.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Warden of this stretch. I have one deputy and he is fifteen.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: {target} is past what the two of us can do. The bounty is real and it is signed.

offers.accept: He tears the warrant along the fold and gives you the half with the seal on it. "{target}. Bring me the other half back."
offers.decline: "Understood." He does not look surprised, and that is the worst of it.
offers.title: The Warden's Warrant
offers.text: A road warden's signed bounty on {target}.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I was there when it was made. I would like to be there when it is unmade, but my hands shake now.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: {target}. Take the purse. It was never mine.

offers.accept: The purse is heavier than it looks and smells of incense. "{target}," they say, and start walking the other way.
offers.decline: They bow, which is somehow worse than an argument, and keep walking.
offers.title: Unmaking
offers.text: A penitent pays in guilt money to see {target} unmade.

offers.npcName: A surveyor with a broken glass

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I map what is left. My last chain-man walked to {target} and the map went blank there.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I need the blank filled in. I will pay for the ink and the risk both.

offers.accept: He rules a hard line to {target} and writes a number beside it that is more than you expected.
offers.decline: He inks a small cross on the map instead, and does not explain what it means.
offers.title: The Blank on the Map
offers.text: A surveyor pays to have {target} cleared so the map can be finished.
